The '''Battle of Vjun''' was an operation carried out by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] against the [[X1's faction|forces]] of [[X1]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], both [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were killed seemingly ending the threat posed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. This allowed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to take its first steps into becoming the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. However, one of the many members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to had survived the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] destruction on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was the former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] known as [[X1]]. With the Emperor dead, he sought to form a new Galactic Empire with himself on the throne and declared himself a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Despite his intentions, X1 lacked the necessary knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and thus sought to find knowledge to support him in this endeavor. To that end, he took Imperial forces loyal to him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] in order to reach [[Bast Castle]]; a stronghold of Darth Vader's and a possible location for many secrets in the dark arts.

Learning that his brother had survived the battle, his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] twin [[X2]] decided to stop him and journeyed alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to Vjun. They had received intelligence data that suggested X1 had formed his new headquarters at Darth Vader's castle and was being defended by his Imperial forces.

==The Battle==
[[File:Stormtroopers_in_Bast_Castle.jpg|thumb|left|260px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] legion in [[Bast Castle]].]]
After entering the Vjun system, X2 worked to eliminate the security satellites around the planet in order to prevent Imperial forces from being aware of the enemy presence in the region. Receiving his orders from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Luke Skywalker, X2 later boarded the orbiting Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] which was unaware of the Republic presence. Once he boarded the ship, the former clone trooper battled [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in order to access the ships database and learn more about what forces were present on the surface of Vjun. Upon [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] the computer terminals, he received the necessary data and later departed the capital ship and headed to the surface of Vjun. Skywalker later informed that the intelligence he had taken from the Imperial warship indicated that X1 had already left the planet, but also indicated that there was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] present on Vjun which needed to be retrieved from inside Bast Castle.

However, the Imperial forces were now fully prepared and had [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] scrambled to protect the installation from harm. Furthermore, stormtroopers were garrisoned as well as mobilized to combat intruders. This necessitated in X2 using his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] to first eliminate the enemy fighters and later land at the hangar where he engaged in combat against the defending stormtroopers. While battling Imperial forces, X2 was informed by Skywalker that the data on the Star Destroyer showed that X1 had taken his [[Clone template/Legends|genetic father]] [[Falon Grey]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and had placed it in Darth Vader's trophy room. Fighting through hordes of Imperial soldiers, X2 managed to enter the trophy room and reclaimed his genetic father's lightsaber that was lost at [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

He later went to find and retrieve the Sith [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and just as he entered the inner sanctum, X2 was confronted by security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] left behind by Darth Vader. Fighting of his assailants, X2 was successful in destroying them and later discovered the existence of the holocron within the [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]] located deep inside Bast Castle. Upon retrieving it, he was attacked by more Imperial troopers and security droids which forced him to make his way back to the hangar to escape and return to Republic forces. The retrieval of the holocron allowed Luke Skywalker and Republic engineers to decode it in order to find out what X1's objectives were as well as his [[Dathomir/Legends|next destination]].
